4dea0473-d3c5-444d-b8ef-e9b015ab43ab.quote: Iggy & Scorch owned our most lopsided win: Argus, Terra and Khaimera in one exchange, then two of their inner towers and an inhibitor fell. Damage ran about a third above his usual on the hero, and he took the last kill before the Core. Terra was the recurring problem, credited with three of his five deaths. Terra's ultimate cleanses on cast and then adds tenacity, so Iggy & Scorch lands Inferno's knockback once that tenacity window ends.
4dea0473-d3c5-444d-b8ef-e9b015ab43ab.issue: takeaway rests on an unverified tenacity-versus-knockback interaction; the catalog lists tenacity on Terra's ultimate but nothing says it shortens Belch's knockback
4dea0473-d3c5-444d-b8ef-e9b015ab43ab.rewrite: Iggy & Scorch owned our most lopsided win: Argus, Terra and Khaimera in one exchange, then two of their inner towers and an inhibitor fell. Damage ran about a third above his usual on the hero, and he took the last kill before the Core. Terra was the recurring problem, credited with three of his five deaths.
